utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just a bit busy with schoolwork.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Oh, it sounds like you have something exciting planned for the weekend! What are you going to do?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I'm thinking of going to the new cinema with some friends. I'm just trying to figure out the best way to get there.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: The one by the old town loop? That's a nice area! Are you going with friends who know the way?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Yes, I'm going with a few friends. We were looking at the map earlier to see if that loop is the quickest route.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Using the map on your phone is a smart choice these days. Just make sure your phone is charged so you don't lose your way!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That's a great point! I'll make sure to bring my portable charger just in case we need the directions later.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I understand, dear. Having a backup makes things simpler. Just be safe and mind the traffic on the road.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Do you have any other plans for the day after your little trip to the cinema?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Not really, just planning to relax and maybe catch up on some shows once I'm back home.
